nodes.label: Async-first
nodes.rationale: Use async/await for I/O operations to avoid blocking the event loop.

nodes.label: Security by Default
nodes.rationale: Never trust user input; validate early and fail fast with HTTPException.

nodes.label: Dependency Injection
nodes.rationale: Use FastAPI Depends() for auth, validation, and shared request-scoped resources.

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern
nodes.rationale: Use deleted_at timestamp instead of hard deletes to retain recoverability.

nodes.label: Optimistic Locking
nodes.rationale: Use version_id_col to prevent lost updates under concurrent writes.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern
nodes.rationale: Encapsulate CRUD behind BaseRepository generics over AsyncSession.

nodes.label: Eager Loading
nodes.rationale: Use selectinload/joinedload/raiseload to avoid N+1 queries.

nodes.label: Dual ID Pattern
nodes.rationale: Internal integer ID for joins; public UUID for API exposure.

nodes.label: Domain-Driven Project Structure
nodes.rationale: Inspired by Netflix Dispatch; store domain packages under src with router/schemas/models/service.

nodes.label: Password Hashing
nodes.rationale: Never store plaintext passwords; hash with passlib bcrypt.

nodes.label: Qdrant
nodes.rationale: Optional until Phase 4 RAG; gracefully unused before then.

nodes.label: Langfuse
nodes.rationale: Optional observability; gracefully degrades if keys missing.

nodes.label: OpenRouter
nodes.rationale: Documented as default LLM provider; resolve via get_role_config(role).

nodes.label: MESSAGING_DRY_RUN
nodes.rationale: true by default so Twilio will not actually send messages.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes; read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code.

nodes.label: MCP Adapters
nodes.rationale: mcp/langchain-mcp-adapters require Python 3.10+; AGENT_USE_MCP=false falls back to in-process tools.

nodes.label: Escalation Inbox (Unified HITL Queue)
nodes.rationale: Payment receipts and talk-to-tutor requests share one escalations inbox with reason_code differentiation.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy Isolation
nodes.rationale: Root boundary is tenants.id; every application query must filter by tenant_id.

nodes.label: Resource Agent Drive vs RAG Split
nodes.rationale: Drive sends file links (papers/textbooks/syllabus); RAG answers questions from tutor notes in Qdrant.
nodes.norm_label: resource agent drive vs rag split

nodes.label: Escalation-Only HITL
nodes.rationale: One escalations inbox instead of separate payments queue; less schema and one staff workflow for hackathon delivery. Bot always completes pipeline and never blocks waiting for a human.

nodes.label: No human_mode / Bot Mute (Skipped)
nodes.rationale: chat_sessions + human_mode skipped; bot keeps chatting after talk_to_tutor ack.

nodes.label: MCP_INCLUDE_DRIVE=false Default
nodes.rationale: Twilio live webhook and Google Drive MCP deferred from Phase 6 gate; crm+rag+memory only.

nodes.label: Twilio WhatsApp Sandbox Channel
nodes.rationale: Matches student WhatsApp UX without Meta Business API complexity for hackathon.

nodes.label: No Redis Message Queue (MVP)
nodes.rationale: Twilio allows ~15s webhook timeout; use FastAPI BackgroundTasks instead of Redis workers.

nodes.label: Copy-from-Reference Policy (BookMe + Week 13)
nodes.rationale: Every phase ports existing modules from BookMe AI and Week 13; adapt tuition domain only, do not invent patterns.
